citations.citation: For a poetic and essayistic oeuvre that renews lyric, verse narrative, elegy and the essay through a sustained encounter with classical antiquity, grief and desire, in which philological learning and formal invention work as one practice.

For a poetic and essayistic oeuvre that renews lyric, verse narrative and elegy through a sustained encounter with classical antiquity, in which translation and original writing form one practice, and that gives formal invention emotional and intellectual weight.

For a poetic and essayistic oeuvre that renews lyric, verse narrative and elegy through a learned and emotionally charged encounter with antiquity, in which scholarship, translation and the shaping of the book become part of one imaginative practice.

For a poetic and essayistic oeuvre that renews lyric, verse narrative and elegy through hybrid forms, in which classical learning, translation, grief and desire become a single, unmistakable practice of formal daring and emotional and intellectual depth.

citations.citation: For a visionary body of poetry and prose in Romanian that builds memory, the body and metaphysical speculation into a large, unmistakably personal imaginative architecture.

For a visionary Romanian oeuvre, from the early poetry to the Blinding trilogy and Solenoid, in which memory, the body and dream are given the form of densely patterned, encyclopedic metaphysical prose.
